::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 10th 1860  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell
:::

My dear [Mrs Moor](people/person_1044.qmd),

I am afraid Otterbourne will be unrepresented at [Ampfield](organizations/other_124.qmd)[^1] on the 21st, as [Mamma](people/person_1606.qmd) and I are going on the 17th to London for a few days, chiefly to meet the Colbornes on their return from Ireland.[^2] I did not write before because our plans were not fully fixed.  We shall not be long gone, but it is a pity we just miss your celebration.

yours sincerely

CMYonge

---

[^1]: Ampfield was the neighbouring parish where Mrs Moor’s husband was perpetual curate.
[^2]: FMY's stepbrother [Lord Seaton](people/person_313.qmd) served as commander-in-chief of the army in Ireland 1855-1860.
